---
title: "plotting speech strata"
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(here)
library(viridis)
library(cowplot)
library(gt)
library(rlang)

speech_df <- readRDS(here("_data", "_primary_data", "speech_df.RDS"))

wave_2_dfs <- readRDS(here("_data", "_participant_scores", "wave_2", "wave_2_dfs.RDS"))
pilot_2_dfs <- readRDS(here("_data", "_participant_scores", "wave_2", "pilot_2_dfs.RDS"))

speech_IDs <- bind_rows(
  wave_2_dfs[["speeches1"]] |> select(item_ID), 
  wave_2_dfs[["speeches2"]] |> select(item_ID), 
  pilot_2_dfs[["speeches1"]] |> select(item_ID),
  pilot_2_dfs[["speeches2"]] |> select(item_ID)) |> 
  
  filter(!item_ID == "attention") |> unique() |> pull()

colors <- viridis(10) 

rm(wave_2_dfs)
```

# bar plots

```{r}
speech_df |> 
  
  filter(id %in% speech_IDs) |>
  
  count(president, party, name = "n") |>
  
  mutate(president = fct_reorder(president, n, .desc = T)) |>
  
  ggplot(aes(x = president, y = n, fill = party)) +
    geom_col(alpha = .75) +
    coord_flip() +
    labs(x = NULL, y = "Count") +
        scale_fill_manual(values = c(colors[5], colors[9])) + 
    theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "none")
```
